exposure: Type of antenatal care (ANC) facility (private vs public)
cohort: The study surveyed 417 pregnant women at >=28 weeks gestation seeking antenatal care at 22 selected health facilities in Conakry, Guinea.
finding: The prevalence of symptoms suggestive of antepartum depression was 34.5% (95% CI: 30.1-39.2) among the surveyed women.
cross-section timing: Third trimester (at >=28 weeks gestation) during antenatal care
